'''Michael Kessling Day 2 Kessling's Report (tournament report)''' is the tournament report [[Mike Kessling]] posted on DeckTech on 12 October 2000 about [[2000 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="tr-d1332">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-12-day-2-kesslings-reportd1332/ day-2-kesslings-report], DeckTech (Michael "Troop1023" Kessling, 12 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-12-day-2-kesslings-reportd1332/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Michael Kessling posted a pointer to his DecipherCon 2000 Day 2 report, which he hosted off-site on Angelfire.

== Report info ==
* '''Author:''' [[Mike Kessling]] (byline: Michael "Troop1023" Kessling)

* '''Event:''' [[2000 Decipher World Championship]]

== Original report ==

'''day-2-kesslings-report'''
* '''Author:''' Michael "Troop1023" Kessling
* '''Published:''' Oct 12, 2000

<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-family:inherit"><nowiki>
  Hello people...



I don’t care what you say, or if you even call me "cupcake"...I am being funny and people are liking it. So sorry Mr. Keefer if it offended you. This report may contain obcenities....it is here:The Report..I think that link should work...if not the report is at:



www.angelfire.com/ga3/TREPORT2



Mike Kessling
</nowiki></div>
